Travel and exploration

Car won't refuel? Check which fuel you have

Copters, buggies, roadside cars, trains and mining quarries use Fuel Bottles. Factory fuel is a different item and cannot go into vehicle fuel slots. Check the item before trying again.

Fuel Bottles need no research and can also be found in loot. Hunting provides Animal Fat for crafting; check the crafting menu for materials and batch output. Refuel and bring spare bottles before a long trip.
